lessons: Criterion 1 contradicts the code. In clutch/requisition.py::review_ticket (lines 257-270), begin_watch runs on every call while driver._active is None. Driver.race resets _active after each call, so the invalid-then-approve size-1 run calls begin_watch twice, not once.

Amend criterion 1 to require two begin_watch calls with identical arguments, one per call, which is today's behavior. Do not change the size-1 path to call it once: Definition of rejected forbids any size-1 change to calls or side effects.

Criterion 3 also says one begin_watch for three member calls. Under the same per-call rule there would be three calls with identical arguments. Restate it as one begin_watch per llm_call with the same identity. Driver.begin_watch (clutch/driver.py:553-557) returns early for a repeated identity.

Goal's 'one watch' means one watch identity (owner, run_seq, surface, attempt), which Driver.begin_watch already deduplicates. It does not mean one begin_watch call. Have the author state this so later attempts don't read it as a call count.
